items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: And we had Carl George on trumpet.

ctx.x: We had five saxophones. You directed most of the time.

That's right. And we had Carl George on trumpet. Carl George used to play with Stan Kenton. He's a black boy that went to school and studied under Gustave. And he played one of the most beautiful trumpets you ever

heard in your life. He played first trumpet in Stan Kenton's band for about five years, didn't he? About five years. Earl George. He played with us. We had Torran on the trombone. We had Bill Moore on the bass, Chester Lane on the piano. That was when Count Basie started giving us some arrangements, you know, and we used to rehearse arrangements. And we brought in Larry Steele to produce the shows. He came in.
